Under this, proposals have been submitted to the government seeking funds. Accordingly, the issue of devolution of funds to the Zila Parishads was under consideration of the Government.

Government Decision: - "Sant Sewalal Maharaj Banjara / Laman Tanda Samriddhi Yojana" Account Title (2515 2753) 31 Subsidized Grants Year 2025-26 A total of Rs. 100.00 crore has been sanctioned, out of which 60 per cent of the funds from the Department of Finance is limited to Rs. 60.00 crore has been received.

2. Reference No. Proposals for seeking funds have been received by the Government under Sections 16 to 28. Accordingly, the total amount demanded for funds is Rs. The amount of Rs. 28,60,00, 000 / - (Rupees Twenty-eight Crore Sixty Lakhs only) is being disbursed to the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Parishad of the State as follows.

The CEO of the concerned Zilla Parishad is being declared as the controlling officer for the distribution of these funds and funds are being made available to them through the BEAMS system. Care should be taken to carry out the work as per the prescribed schedule and within the stipulated time frame under the scheme.
The CEO of the concerned Zilla Parishad shall strictly adhere to the terms and conditions mentioned in the Government Decision at Reference No. 1 while disbursing the said funds.
5. The work for which funds have been made available should be spent. The Chief Executive Officer of the Zilla Parishad will be responsible for ensuring that the work is not done by any other scheme.

6. The concerned Zilla Parishad shall take care of the proper utilization of the funds sanctioned by the Government. These works should be reviewed and monitored from time to time and the information about the works should be useful.

The certificate should be submitted along with it to the government within the prescribed time. Also, Reference No. The Chief Executive Officer, Zilla Parishad shall be responsible for the allocation and expenditure of 2 per cent of the funds sanctioned for each district towards administrative expenses as provided in the Government Decision herein.

7. After completion of development works, care should be taken to have the nameplate of the work done under Sant Sewalal Maharaj Banjara / Laman Tanda Improvement Scheme prominently displayed at the workplace.

8. Orders / Rules / Administrative Decisions / Financial Rules issued by the State Government from time to time regarding the scheme and finances shall be implemented by the respective District Councils. The funds are being disbursed subject to these conditions.

9. Utilization certificates regarding the appropriation of the said grant-in-aid should be sent to the Office of the Accountant General, Mumbai and this Department. Also, the terms and conditions of the Government Circular No. FY-2024 / Q. 80 / FY-3, dated 25th July, 2024 of the Department of Finance should be complied with.
